verdict.rationale: Paddle can be driven entirely without its dashboard. It offers a Bearer-token Billing API with scoped permissions and key rotation (including automated AWS Secrets Manager rotation), four official server-side SDKs, and an OpenAPI 3.1 spec. A separate sandbox with `pdl_sdbx_` keys suits automated test runs, and a hosted MCP server accepts API-key auth and can simulate webhook events. Missing for 10: an official CLI, CI-specific guidance (e.g. pipeline or GitHub Actions examples), headless test support for Paddle Retain (sandbox not supported), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.
